findings.description: routes.ts calls repository.ts's findByDeliveryId directly for the dedupe check instead of routing through service.ts — and this path skips HMAC signature verification entirely, since that only runs inside service.handleDelivery.
service.ts queries db/schema directly for the workspace lookup instead of adding a method to repository.ts.
service.ts constructs the concrete HmacWebhookVerifier itself instead of resolving it through platform/container.ts, the sole composition root allowed to wire an interface to its implementation.
Imports FastifyRequest into reviewer-core, a framework-free domain package.
Imports PullRow from server/src/db into reviewer-core, crossing the domain/infra boundary reviewer-core must never cross.

fetchFanInFromGitHub calls the GitHub API directly inside domain code instead of receiving that data through an injected interface — an un-gated second side effect alongside the one injected LLMProvider reviewer-core is meant to have.
service.ts only forwards list/markRead to the repository with zero logic, while the module's real logic (existence check, unread-count derivation) leaked into routes.ts instead of living here.
The 'userId must exist' invariant is encoded as an async Zod .refine() in routes.ts instead of living in service.ts.
The POST handler calls repository.ts's insert directly instead of going through service.ts.
The unread-count handler imports db/schema directly and queries the table itself instead of going through repository.ts.
